title: Advanced version of Gemini with Deep Think officially achieves gold-medal standard at the International Mathematical Olympiad
summary: The International Mathematical Olympiad (“IMO”) is the world’s most prestigious competition for young mathematicians, and has been held annually since 1959. Each country taking part is represented by six elite, pre-university mathematicians who compete to solve six exceptionally difficult problems in algebra, combinatorics, geometry, and number theory.
body: The International Mathematical Olympiad (“IMO”) is the world’s most prestigious competition for young mathematicians, and has been held annually since 1959. Each country taking part is represented by six elite, pre-university mathematicians who compete to solve six exceptionally difficult problems in algebra, combinatorics, geometry, and number theory.
summaryZh: 谷歌 DeepMind 宣布，搭载 Deep Think 深度思考功能的增强版 Gemini 模型在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛（IMO）评测中正式达到了金牌选手标准。IMO 是全球顶级的青年数学竞赛，涉及代数、组合数学、几何和数论等极其复杂的难题。这一突破证明了顶级大模型在解决高度复杂符号推理与形式化数学证明领域的巨大进步。
